title: Around the Room (optional)
originalObjective: Students write and solve their own story problems involving addition and subtraction; optional around-the-room exercise with addition of three addends.

teacherRubric.required: Learner really composed an original coherent story; cannot be proven by a numeric generated answer alone
The story uses an intelligible quantity and real action (join, remove, or combine groups)
The story supplies enough quantities and one answerable question without contradiction
A drawing, number bond or complete equation reflects every described group and the correctly placed unknown
Independent review confirms nonnegative within-20 math, accurate result, and all three addends when using a three-group story
Teacher-led observation/peer comments are recorded truthfully if this classroom activity is actually conducted

gradingPolicy: Fail closed: numeric arithmetic Practice may supplement authoring but MUST NOT certify this creative/teacher-reviewed lesson.
notes: This is first-party proposed review guidance, not a copied official publisher rubric or a claimed teacher signoff.
